result.instructions: Tools for Enchant, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Enchant data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run enchant_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run enchant_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run enchant_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. enchant_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: enchant_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List and filter tickets (newest first by default). Enchant REST: GET /tickets. Use user_ids ["null"] for unassigned tickets. Each result has a short summary; use enchant_get_ticket for messages.

inbox_ids.description: Only tickets in these inbox ids.

user_ids.description: Only tickets assigned to these user ids ("null" = unassigned).

label_ids.description: Only tickets with these label ids.

types.description: Ticket types, e.g. email, chat, sms, phone, web, twitter, whatsapp.

spam.description: Only spam (true) or only non-spam (false) tickets.

trash.description: Only trashed (true) or only non-trashed (false) tickets.

since_created_at.description: Only tickets created since this UTC ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-01-31T13:41:10Z.

since_updated_at.description: Only tickets updated since this UTC ISO 8601 time.

sort.description: Sort order; a leading - means descending.

per_page.description: Results per page (0-100, default 10). Use 0 with count to get only the total.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Past 10,000 results, filter by since_created_at instead.

count.description: If true, also return the total number of matching results (costs 1 extra rate-limit credit).

tools.name: enchant_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by id. Embed related data with `embed`: messages (the conversation: replies and notes), customer, user, inbox, labels. Each embedded type costs 1 extra rate-limit credit. Enchant REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

id.description: Ticket id (the string id, not the friendly ticket number).

tools.name: enchant_list_users
tools.title: List users (agents)
tools.description: List the help desk users (agents): id, name, email. Use the ids to assign tickets and to author replies and notes. Enchant REST: GET /users.

per_page.description: Results per page (0-100, default 10). Use 0 with count to get only the total.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Past 10,000 results, filter by since_created_at instead.

tools.name: enchant_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers, or find one by contact: set contact_type and contact_value (for example email + an address). Enchant REST: GET /customers.

contact_type.description: Contact type to match (use with contact_value).

contact_value.description: Email address or Twitter screen name to match (use with contact_type).

since_created_at.description: Only customers created since this UTC ISO 8601 time.

per_page.description: Results per page (0-100, default 10). Use 0 with count to get only the total.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Past 10,000 results, filter by since_created_at instead.

count.description: If true, also return the total number of matching results (costs 1 extra rate-limit credit).

tools.name: enchant_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with the contacts (emails, phones, Twitter names). Enchant REST: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_get_attachment
tools.title: Get attachment
tools.description: Get the metadata of an attachment (name, size, MIME type) by id; attachment ids appear in ticket messages. Enchant REST: GET /attachments/{id}.

tools.name: enchant_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: WRITE: create an email ticket. Give customer_id, or a customer (matched by contact email, created if new). Optionally add the customer's first message with body (needs the customer's email). Enchant REST: POST /tickets.

customer_id.description: Existing customer id. Give this or customer.

customer.description: Customer to find or create, instead of customer_id.

email.description: Email address; used to find or create the customer.

body.description: First inbound message from the customer (plain text).

user_id.description: User id to assign the ticket to.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (the default inbox if omitted).

tools.name: enchant_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: WRITE: change a ticket: state (open, hold, closed), assignee, inbox, subject, spam or trash (not both true). label_ids REPLACES all labels (empty array clears them); use enchant_add_ticket_labels to keep existing ones. Enchant REST: PATCH /tickets/{id}.

user_id.description: Assign to this user id; null unassigns the ticket.

label_ids.description: The full new set of label ids (replaces existing labels).

spam.description: Mark as spam. Cannot be true together with trash.

trash.description: Send to trash. Cannot be true together with spam.

tools.name: enchant_add_ticket_labels
tools.title: Add labels to ticket
tools.description: WRITE: add one or more labels to a ticket without changing its other labels. Enchant REST: PUT /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_remove_ticket_labels
tools.title: Remove labels from ticket
tools.description: WRITE: remove one or more labels from a ticket; its other labels stay. Enchant REST: DELETE /tickets/{id}/labels/{label_ids}.

tools.name: enchant_reply_to_ticket
tools.title: Reply to customer
tools.description: WRITE: send an outbound reply on a ticket. This SENDS A REAL EMAIL to the customer address in `to`. Use enchant_add_note for an internal note. Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type reply, direction out).

user_id.description: Id of the user (agent) the reply is sent as; see enchant_list_users.

to.description: Recipient address, normally the customer's email.

html.description: True if body is HTML (default false: plain text).

tools.name: enchant_add_note
tools.title: Add internal note
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal note to a ticket (not sent to the customer). Enchant REST: POST /tickets/{id}/messages (type note).

user_id.description: Id of the user (agent) the note is from; see enchant_list_users.

html.description: True if body is HTML (default false: plain text).

tools.name: enchant_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer with optional contacts (email, twitter, phone). Enchant REST: POST /customers.

summary.description: Short free-text summary shown on the customer profile.

value.description: Email address, Twitter screen name or phone number.

tools.name: enchant_update_customer
tools.title: Update customer
tools.description: WRITE: update a customer's name or summary. If `contacts` is given, it REPLACES the contact list; use enchant_add_customer_contact to add one. Enchant REST: PATCH /customers/{id}.

summary.description: Short free-text summary shown on the customer profile.

contacts.description: The full new contact list (replaces the existing one).

value.description: Email address, Twitter screen name or phone number.

tools.name: enchant_add_customer_contact
tools.title: Add customer contact
tools.description: WRITE: add one contact (email, twitter or phone) to a customer. Enchant REST: POST /customers/{id}/contacts.

value.description: Email address, Twitter screen name or phone number.

tools.name: enchant_delete_customer_contact
tools.title: Delete customer contact
tools.description: WRITE, DELETES DATA: remove one contact from a customer. Enchant REST: DELETE /customers/{id}/contacts/{contact_id}.
